import os,glob,re,itertools
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load(); print(sorted(G))
gi,go=G['Demo pair 1 input'],G['Demo pair 1 output']
H,W=len(gi),len(gi[0])
seen=[[False]*W for _ in range(H)]
rects=[]
for i in range(H):
    for j in range(W):
        c=gi[i][j]
        if c==0 or seen[i][j]: continue
        st=[(i,j)]; seen[i][j]=True; comp=[]
        while st:
            y,x=st.pop(); comp.append((y,x))
            for dy,dx in itertools.product((-1,0,1),repeat=2):
                ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and not seen[ny][nx] and gi[ny][nx]==c:
                    seen[ny][nx]=True; st.append((ny,nx))
        ys=[p[0] for p in comp]; xs=[p[1] for p in comp]
        h=max(ys)-min(ys)+1; w=max(xs)-min(xs)+1
        rect=all(0<=a<h and 0<=b<w for a,b in [(y-min(ys),x-min(xs)) for y,x in comp])
        rects.append((c,len(comp),h*w,h,w,rect,min(ys),min(xs)))
print([r for r in rects if len(r)==4])
